notes: Original Drosophila whole-brain LIF model from Shiu et al. (Nature 2024). Extracted LIF membrane equations (V_rest = -52mV, V_thresh = -45mV, dt = 1ms, tau_m = 10ms) and FlyWire v630 connectome topology concepts.
Large-scale whole-brain SNN implementation supporting Brian2, PyTorch, and CUDA. Studied sparse CSR matrix representations and GPU batching pipelines.
Modular circuit architecture (NeuroArch, Neurokernel, NeuroMynerva). Studied executable circuit specifications and central complex / mushroom body neuropil connectivity.
Connectome-driven SNN for sensorimotor control in walking Drosophila. Studied spike transmission delays and premotor descending neuron circuits.
Large-scale sparse spiking network simulation scaling over FlyWire data. Studied sparse recurrent synaptic weight initialization.
Real-time browser-oriented simulation concepts and sparse connectivity graphs for interactive execution.
Whole-CNS brain and ventral nerve cord modeling. Studied sensory feature encoding vectors and motor readout mapping.
MaleCNS connectome dataset integration and sparse graph clustering algorithms.
Fly visual system orientation selectivity and spatial receptive field mapping in LIF networks.
High-performance spiking neural network simulation algorithms using compressed sparse representations.
